"'''The Missing Life Day Feast / The Lost Treasure of Tenoo'''" is the ninth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 14]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Official description==
''The Jedi save Life Day. Kai and Djovi face Blackbolt.''
